caption:
This satellite is made of one million of its own photos.

Swift flew for nearly 22 years.
It fell back to Earth on 4 November and burned up over Sumatra.
The active Sun pulled its orbit lower, and a rescue boost failed.

What the astronomers say: Astronomers say Swift studied the fastest, most energetic blasts in the universe, and its data will keep helping.
